definitions.explanation: A young person, or someone's son or daughter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧{子|こ}です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I often played here when I was a child.

notes:
{子|こ} is a fundamental word meaning child. It functions both as a standalone word and as a productive element in many compounds.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{子|こ}: good child (also used to praise pets)
- ⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧: boy
- ⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧: girl
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{子|こ}: that child/kid (casual; also used for young adults)

AS A PREFIX (= young/baby):
- ⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧: puppy
- {子猫|こねこ}: kitten
- {子鹿|こじか}: fawn
- ⟦{子牛|こうし}→子牛：27912_koushi⟧: calf

IN COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧: parent and child
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: children (most common form)
- ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧: child-rearing

USAGE:
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{子|こ} can refer to young adults casually, not just children. In this usage, it is similar to "that person" but informal.
